en: Black-and-white panoramic view of a mountain village nestled in a valley. In the background are steep, rugged mountains with dense forests. Toward the left on the mountainside there is printed text with an arrow pointing to a specific area labeled 'VALLE DI TOVEL'. In the foreground is the clustered town with tiled-roof houses and a prominent church tower. At the bottom of the image, handwritten-style caption text reads 'Tuenno m. 629 - Panorama'.
